record.name: Mauritania
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The digital-transformation ministry referred to adoption of the national AI strategy in November 2024; the cited sources name no government-designated body to evaluate advanced models.

searches.query: موريتانيا الذكاء الاصطناعي معهد سلامة حكومة

check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: MR-search = searches 1, 2 (en, ar). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The retrieved draft strategy describes AI governance, data protection, cooperation and a research institute. Draft measures are not treated as implemented institutions.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Digital Transformation, Innovation and Modernization of Administration
related_bodies.role: It authored the draft strategy and owns the policy; it is not an evaluation body.

record.notes:
The strategy proposes an Artificial Intelligence Institute for research and development projects and updates to the regulatory framework. A 2025 cloud agreement appeared only in search results.

The minister's official statement of 2 November 2024 explicitly refers to adoption of the national AI strategy. Searches covered indexed public English and Arabic sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.

next_check.reason: Check whether the 2024-2029 strategy was adopted and whether it created an evaluation function.
